violations.text: The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Establishment must register Food Safety Manager with the RIDOH. Application provided. New Violation. Correct By: 08/27/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine and blower fans in walk in cooler 1 have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. NFCS must be maintained. New Violation. Correct By: 07/30/2026
